title: Pyasa raha jaane
body:
pyasa raha jaan e nabi
ay waye nehre alqama
uth'ti rahi mauje teri
ay waye nehre alqama
<<DIVIDER>>
wo khushk lab sookha gala
sher e khuda ki aal ka
wo tere honton par tari
ay waye nehre alqama
<<DIVIDER>>
toofan uthana tha tujhe
ya sookh jana tha tujhe
kuch tum ne khidmat hi na ki
ay waye nehre alqama
<<DIVIDER>>
ek mashk pani le liye
abbas ke shaane kate
nadhi lahoo ki beh gayi
ay waye nehre alqama
<<DIVIDER>>
doobe lahoo mein yak qalam
kya kya ghiza-laane haram
dekhi ye kashti doobti
ay waye nehre alqama
<<DIVIDER>>
ek chadar e aabe rawan
odhe hue tu nauhakhwan
zainab ki ye be-chadari
ay waye nehre alqama
<<DIVIDER>>
qabze mein tere aab ho
aur pyaas se betaab ho
sheh ke chaman ki har kali
ay waye nehre alqama
<<DIVIDER>>
ashq e sakina beh gaye
moo dekhte sab reh gaye
tu aur teri daryadili
ay waye nehre alqama
<<DIVIDER>>
yeh kaunsa dastoor tha
mehmaan kitni door tha
kya paon mein zanjeer thi
ay waye nehre alqama
<<DIVIDER>>
qaima rahe shabbir ka
yun dhoop mein jalta hua
saahil pe ho fauje shaqi
ay waye nehre alqama
<<DIVIDER>>
hasrat ki ek tahteer thi
khud tere dil par teer thi
jo mauj uthi aisi uthi
ay waye nehre alqama
<<DIVIDER>>
aata hai usko yaad jab
wo karwaan e tashnalab
hai najm ka nauha yehi
ay waye nehre alqama
author: Najm Afandi
